in_hebrew.name: גורדון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Gorden is derived from the Hebrew words 'gur' (hill) and 'dun' (fortress). This name can be translated as 'hill of the fortress'.

in_greek.long_meaning: The name Gorden in Greek is derived from the words 'gordos' (watcher) and 'on' (man). It can be translated as 'watcher, guardian'.
